FamilyWorkspace.title: FamilyWorkspace
FamilyWorkspace.description: Cloud workspace storing a family's educational records, children profiles, agenda, memories, and parental governance state.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID or canonical user ID of the parent who owns this family workspace.

email.description: Email address of the primary parent.

name.description: Display name of the primary parent.

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON snapshot of the family collections (criancas, agenda, memorias, dificuldades, conhecimento, checkins_emocionais, alertas, registro_uso).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the workspace was last synchronized.

/families/{userId}.description: Stores the synchronized family educational workspace isolated strictly by the authenticated parent's UID.
